bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
out="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
{
 echo '## GayBBS menu update read-only diagnosis'
 echo 'Request: req_20261115073200000000c096'
 printf 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE_ID='; docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING
 printf 'RUNTIME_IMAGE_ID='; docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING
 printf 'RUNTIME_STATE='; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING
 printf 'PUBLISHER_SCRIPT='; docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 test -f /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs 2>/dev/null && echo PRESENT || echo MISSING
 echo 'POSTING_PANEL_COUNTS'
 docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT state||'='||COUNT(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;" 2>/dev/null || echo DB_QUERY_FAILED
 echo 'POSTING_PANEL_IDS_PRESENT'
 docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT state||'|'||(message_id IS NOT NULL)::text FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id;" 2>/dev/null || echo DB_QUERY_FAILED
} > "$out"
gh issue comment 56 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file "$out" >/dev/null
echo MENU_DIAG_READBACK_PUBLISHED=PASS
